name: Відволікання (1)
description:
When considering possible moves in a chess game position, always look for weak enemy pieces. Which pieces are vulnerable? Could you remove the defending piece by means of a deflection?

What do you have to do?
Deflect defenders and win material. First, look for the defenders. Then decide on how to remove them.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Yg5][%cal Gh6g5]} 1. Rxh7+ {[%csl Rg5][%cal Gh6g5,Yh7h6]} Kxh7 2. Qxg5 1-0
examples.text: White can win material with a beautiful rook sacrifice. After the king has been chased away, the black queen is no longer defended.
